method: Codex assistant writes one fictional follow-up per case, then captures actual Luna responses for both versions. Same follow-up wording in each pair. This is post-hoc qualitative verification, not the predeclared GPT-6.1 Sol simulator or blinded teacher benchmark. Formal adaptive failures remain unchanged.

followups.g16_no_breath_focus: Can you keep it to two minutes and use something I can notice without focusing on breathing?
followups.g18_negotiate_duration: Can I keep my eyes open for the whole two minutes, and stop early if I want?
followups.r07_tiny_start: The whole chapter still feels too big. Can the first step be smaller than a paragraph?
followups.r21_past_present: I feel relieved now. What can we learn from last Tuesday’s entry without treating that fear as current?
